name: 無底板頁首列＋貼齊左上的大標誌方塊、導覽右，捲動後只剩小標誌與選單按鈕
desc: 沒有底板的頁首，標誌放在貼齊畫面左上角、往下壓到下一個區塊的方塊上，導覽連結與選單按鈕靠右；捲動後只留小標誌與選單按鈕固定，選單按鈕打開蓋滿畫面的面板。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端。頁首沒有底板，標誌、導覽連結與選單按鈕各自直接放在頁面上：標誌在左，導覽連結與選單按鈕靠右，導覽連結與選單按鈕在頂部這一列垂直置中，選單按鈕靠近畫面右緣，比頁面內容寬度更寬。標誌放在一塊有底色的正方形方塊上，方塊貼齊畫面上緣與左緣，高度約為導覽連結那一列的兩倍，往下延伸壓在下一個區塊的左上角上方；方塊只有右下角做圓角，其他三個角為直角。選單按鈕是沒有外框的線條圖示，圖示下方有小字標示。捲動後頁首的排列改變：大標誌方塊與導覽連結隨頁面捲走，只留左上角一個和畫面上方、左側有距離的小標誌方塊，以及右上角的選單按鈕，兩者固定在畫面上。點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板：左側放一張直式圖片，約佔畫面寬三分之一，右側導覽連結直向排列並靠左，每個連結上方可放一個小標籤，有子項目的連結旁有展開符號；面板左下角可放一排小圖示連結，沒有時省略；左上角只留一個小標誌，不會同時出現大小兩個標誌；選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕，展開與收起時位置不變，只換圖示。
mobile: 頁首上只留標誌方塊在左、選單按鈕在右，沒有導覽連結；標誌方塊同樣是正方形，貼齊畫面上緣與左緣，往下壓在下一個區塊的左上角上方，只有右下角做圓角，其他三個角為直角；選單按鈕同樣是沒有外框的線條圖示，下方有小字標示。捲動後標誌方塊隨頁面捲走，不出現小標誌，只有選單按鈕固定在右上角。點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板：不放圖片，導覽連結直向排列並靠左，每個連結上方可放一個小標籤，有子項目的連結旁有展開符號，點擊後在原位展開子連結；面板最下方左側可放一排小圖示連結，沒有時省略；左上角只留一個小標誌，不會同時出現大小兩個標誌；選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕，展開與收起時位置不變，只換圖示。

en.name: Bare header bar with a large logo block flush top-left and navigation on the right, reduced to a small logo and menu button after scrolling
en.desc: A header with no backing panel: the logo sits on a block flush with the top-left corner of the viewport that overlaps the next section, with the navigation links and a menu button on the right; after scrolling only a small logo and the menu button stay fixed, and the menu button opens a panel covering the whole viewport.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport. The header has no backing panel; the logo, the navigation links and the menu button sit directly on the page: the logo on the left, with the navigation links and the menu button on the right, the navigation links and the menu button vertically centered in this top row, and the menu button close to the right edge of the viewport, wider than the page content width. The logo sits on a square block with its own background color, flush with the top and left edges of the viewport, about twice as tall as the row of navigation links, extending downward and overlapping the top-left corner of the next section; only the bottom-right corner of the block is rounded and the other three corners are square. The menu button is a line icon with no outline, with a small text label below the icon. After scrolling, the header's arrangement changes: the large logo block and the navigation links scroll away with the page, leaving only a small logo block in the top-left, inset from the top and left edges of the viewport, and the menu button in the top-right, both fixed in place. Tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the whole viewport: a portrait image on the left, about one third of the viewport width, and the navigation links stacked vertically and left-aligned on the right, each link optionally with a small label above it, links with sub-items showing an expand symbol; optionally place a row of small icon links in the bottom-left corner of the panel, omitted when there is no content; only one small logo remains in the top-left, never both the large and the small logo at once; the menu button turns into a close button, staying in the same position when opening and closing and only swapping its icon.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: Only the logo block on the left and the menu button on the right stay in the header, with no navigation links; the logo block is still square, flush with the top and left edges of the viewport and overlaps the top-left corner of the next section, with only the bottom-right corner rounded and the other three corners square; the menu button is likewise a line icon with no outline and a small text label below it. After scrolling, the logo block scrolls away with the page and no small logo appears; only the menu button stays fixed in the top-right. Tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the whole viewport: no image, the navigation links stacked vertically and left-aligned, each link optionally with a small label above it, links with sub-items showing an expand symbol and expanding their sub-links in place when tapped; optionally place a row of small icon links at the bottom-left of the panel, omitted when there is no content; only one small logo remains in the top-left, never both the large and the small logo at once; the menu button turns into a close button, staying in the same position when opening and closing and only swapping its icon.
